title: Crypto: XChaCha20-Poly1305 encrypted entry
description: SAR archive with one entry encrypted with XChaCha20-Poly1305. Uses a test-only password-derived key. Validates AEAD encryption/decryption for the XChaCha variant.
notes: Test password: 'sar-test-password-xchacha'. DO NOT use for real data.
Key derived via PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 with fixed test parameters.
